app.layoutFailed: The layout could not be loaded: {error}
app.notUnlocked: This display has not been unlocked yet ({error}) Open the address once with “#token=” and the access token appended – the display will remember the access afterwards.
app.offline: No connection to the core – retrying

editor.saved: Saved. The displays pick up the layout by themselves.
editor.unsaved: There are unsaved changes. The draft stays in this browser until it is saved or discarded.
editor.stale: This layout has been changed from elsewhere in the meantime.
editor.keepMine: Save my version – overwrite the other
editor.needsAdmin: Editing needs access of level “admin”. Open the address once with “#token=” and the token of that access at the end.
editor.hint: Tap a tile to select it. Drag to move it, use the handles at corners and edges to resize. Arrow keys move, with Shift they resize.
editor.occupied: No room there: tiles must not overlap.
editor.noRoom: There is no free room for “{name}”. Shrink, move or remove a tile first.
editor.unknownType: The editor does not know this kind of tile; its place can still be changed.
editor.badJson: This is not a valid JSON object: {error}
editor.rescaleHint: With conversion the tiles keep their share of the screen. Without it they stay where they are – this adds free room at the edge.
editor.screenHint: Size of the screen the layout is meant for, in pixels – or just the ratio, such as 16 and 9. This view follows it; the display itself always fills its screen.
editor.gridRange: Columns and rows are whole numbers from 1 to {max}.
editor.screenRange: Width and height of the screen are numbers greater than zero.
editor.gridCollides: In the grid {columns} × {rows} tiles would overlap or lie outside. Enlarge, move or remove tiles first.
editor.gridRounded: Not all tiles fit the new grid exactly – their edges were moved to the nearest line. Please check; ↶ takes it back.
editor.nameHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens – the name is part of the display's address (?layout=name).
editor.saveFirst: Save or discard first – then the layout can be renamed.
editor.lastLayout: The last layout cannot be deleted.
editor.renameWarn: Displays that carry “?layout={name}” in their address will no longer find the layout.

value-tile.name: Value
value-tile.text: A reading with status dot and trend line – or as a ring that fills with it.

switches.name: Switches
switches.text: A panel of switches; awnings, shutters and blinds can be moved too.

chart.name: Chart
chart.text: The course of values for today, the week or the month.

presence.name: Presence
presence.text: Who is at home and who is not.

weather.name: Weather
weather.text: Conditions, wind, UV index and the forecast for the coming days.

sun-moon.name: Sun and moon
sun-moon.text: Rise and set, length of day and phase of the moon.

video.name: Camera
video.text: The live picture of a camera; tapping fills the screen.

radio.name: Radio
radio.text: Station buttons, volume and the current title.

media-window.name: Media window
media-window.text: The picture of a TV station, the logo of a radio station.

news.name: News
news.text: One story with picture, in turn from all feeds.

image.name: Image
image.text: An image from a web address that renews itself – a webcam, for example.

web.name: Web page
web.text: A web page inside the tile, such as the rain radar.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.text: The next appointments, grouped by day.

mail.name: E-mail
mail.text: The e-mails of all mailboxes, newest first.

checklist.name: List
checklist.text: A shopping or to-do list to tick off.

recipes.name: Recipes
recipes.text: A recipe with picture in rotation; tapping opens it.

clock.name: Clock
clock.text: Time and date; tapping sets the egg timer.

voice.name: Speak
voice.text: Tap and say a sentence instead of typing.

note.name: Note
note.text: Keeps a place free and labels it.

value-tile.secondaryHint: A second value, small beside or below – humidity with temperature, for example.
value-tile.unitHint: Only needed if the datapoint gives no unit or an unsuitable one.
value-tile.factorHint: Converts the value for display, such as 100 for a share of 0.58.
value-tile.gaugeHint: With a largest value the number stands in a ring that fills with it, if the tile is tall enough.
value-tile.freshHint: While this switch is off, the tile is greyed out.

switches.upHint: Only for covers: a caption instead of the arrow, such as “in”.

chart.area: Fill the area under the line
chart.forecast: Forecast (dashed, may reach into the future)

presence.label: Name
presence.homeHint: Only needed if the source delivers text instead of a switch, such as home. Separate with commas.

weather.codeHint: Code or icon id from OpenWeatherMap; more precise than the text.

video.streamHint: Id of the stream as set up in the video source.
video.tvHint: While a TV station plays there, the tile shows its picture instead of the camera.

media-window.idleHint: Id of a stream of the video source, such as another camera.

news.feedsHint: Ids of the feeds, separated by commas; empty shows all.

web.zoomHint: 0.5 shows twice as much of the page.

checklist.listHint: Id or name; empty shows the first list of the source.

clock.timerHint: Without an egg timer the clock only shows the time.

voice.wakeWordHint: Such as “computer”: the display then listens all the time and carries out what is said after the word.

form.jsonOnly: This setting contains entries the form cannot show. It stays as it is and can be changed as JSON under “Advanced”.

picker.more: The first {shown} of {count} – search to narrow down.

sources.title: Sources
sources.idHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. The id becomes the prefix of the datapoints (“id:name”) and cannot be changed later.
sources.choose: Choose a source to set it up – or add a new one below.
sources.undescribed: This plugin does not describe its settings; they can be changed as JSON.
sources.secretsHint: Credentials are only written. The core never hands them out again – this only shows whether something is stored. An empty field leaves the entry as it is.
sources.otherHint: For entries whose name follows from the settings – such as “private.password” for the mailbox “private”.
sources.badJson: This is not a valid JSON object: {error}
sources.removeSure: Really remove “{name}”? Tiles that depend on it will show nothing afterwards.
sources.saved: Saved – the source has been restarted. Its messages above show whether it reaches its device.
sources.savedFailed: Saved, but the source does not start: {error}
sources.unsaved: There are unsaved changes to this source.
sources.needsAdmin: Setting up sources needs access of level “admin”. Open the address once with “#token=” and the token of that access at the end.
sources.runningNote: “running” means the source has started. Whether it reaches its device shows in its messages above and in the number of its datapoints – some sources need a few seconds for that.
sources.notYet: This source has not been created yet. Enter settings and credentials, then “Create and start”.
sources.noNotes: The source has reported nothing since it started.
sources.help: How to set up this source

radio.tapToStart: Tap here to start the sound

news.inOwnWindow: The article is open in a separate window on top of the display because {feed} does not allow embedding. “Close” brings the display back.
news.blocked: The browser did not open the article window. Allow pop-ups for this page or open the article via “In a separate window”.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.choose: Choose a recipe on the left.
recipes.empty: No recipes yet. Put Markdown files into the recipe folder.
recipes.showAll: Show all recipes | Show all recipes | Show all {n} recipes
recipes.addIntro: A web page, a document or a photo of the recipe is enough – it becomes a recipe in this collection. For that, the source is sent to the Claude API by Anthropic.
recipes.addFileHint: PDF, Word, LibreOffice, text or image
recipes.addText: Or paste the text of the recipe
recipes.addBusy: Reading the recipe – this takes up to a minute.
recipes.shopDone: Nothing new added to the shopping list. | 1 ingredient added to the shopping list. | {n} ingredients added to the shopping list.
recipes.shopKnown: – | 1 was already there. | {n} were already there.

timer.title: Kitchen timer
timer.tapToStop: Time is up – tap to switch off

calendar.title: Appointments
calendar.none: No appointments in the coming days

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.noPhone: No phone number is stored for this contact.

checklist.title: List
checklist.login: The sign-in details for the list are missing or rejected.
checklist.noGroup: The account for the list is not a member of any group yet.

voice.title: Speak
voice.start: Speak: tap and say a sentence
voice.notReady: Voice control is not set up yet.
voice.unavailable: Speech recognition is not available in this browser. You can type the sentence:
voice.denied: The browser may not use the microphone. You can type the sentence:

web.mixed: This display runs over HTTPS and can therefore only embed HTTPS pages.
web.refused: This page does not allow embedding ({detail}).
